sayLines: 📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
You've learned Old World Caches — it carries Eagle Eye.

Travel 1 tile to grove.
— Nut trees —
Mast crunches underfoot — last season's nuts, sprouting or rotting. The trees don't waste anything.
Something moves out there — the humming in the grass.
Movement — a box turtle, ancient and unhurried.
👁 Slow. Walk up and pick it up. That's the whole hunt.

Travel 1 tile to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
A woodpecker works somewhere you can't see. Down here it smells of mushrooms and cold shade.
It followed you. The humming in the grass is here.
Movement — a deer, white tail raised in alarm.
👁 Wary. Ears always tracking. Get close before it knows you're there.
You see smoke on the horizon. Emberhold — 12 people, 5 days in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 4 plants — 4 new to you. They've been here the whole time.

Travel 1 tile to trail edge.
— An old trail —
